The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 50c54704fe210d89), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The functions T± are smooth on (0, ∞) × X and satisfy ∂pT = (L + Bp · ∇)T, L = 1 8 X w=x,y  3 4 X i=1 ∂wiwi + 4 X i=1 X j̸=i cot wi − wj 2 ∂wi   . (4.1) For every p0 > 0 and every fixed finite derivative order k, the vector field Bp extends smoothly across angle collisions and ∥Bp∥Ck ≤ Ck,p0 e−p (p ≥ p0). It is equivariant under permutations within either tuple, common rotations, and cyclic relabelings. In particular, its normal component at every collision face is zero.
